name: actor-21-patent-ip-enforcement-monitor
title: USPTO PTAB + EPO Opposition - Patent Dispute Delta API
description: Tracks USPTO PTAB patent-dispute proceedings (IPR/PGR/CBM/Derivation), plus an optional EPO opposition-watch module for a caller-supplied EP watchlist. Both sources are BYOK via free registration; delta mode flags new, updated, and concluded proceedings. PatentsView/WIPO out of scope.
